card.name: Start of drug names after 'with'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or drug name, or the word 'the' before 'label', right after words like 'with', 'of', 'after' or 'follow'. It fires in label text where a named product is about to be spelled out.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: First letters of a capitalized brand name after a linking word such as with, of, or after.

modes.description: Inside a drug or disease abbreviation, before the rest of it.
